prompt:
Use case: compositing / logo-brand.
Make ONE square comparison sheet with FOUR new polished mobile APP ICON variations, 2x2 grid, labeled 20, 21, 22, 23 beneath the square icon tiles, outside the artwork. Equal size square tiles, quiet warm-ivory sheet, generous equal gutters. Exactly four icons.

STYLE LOCK: In input image 1, the user selected ONLY icon 19 at the BOTTOM RIGHT. Match THAT icon's tactile die-cut sticker badge treatment: the character(s) and ONEBEAT wordmark share ONE continuous thick warm-ivory cutout border, with a substantial hard near-black extruded side offset DOWN AND RIGHT. The finished badge should feel like a thick flat comic sticker with physical depth and a crisp black underside. Preserve the hand-inked original artwork, not glossy plastic 3D. ALL FOUR tiles have the same pale-lavender #C5B7EB full-bleed square background so this compares characters, not different styles. No rounded tile corners, no outer app-icon frames.
WORDMARK LOCK: Input image 2 contains coral Chinese text and an English wordmark. Use ONLY its English "ONEBEAT", preserving the exact bold condensed italic uppercase letter shapes with bright teal face, heavy near-black outline and hard extrusion. Spell exactly ONEBEAT in all four icons. All letters fully visible. Integrate the wordmark prominently across the lower 35–40% of the badge, angled slightly upward, partly in front of the characters' torsos but NEVER across a face. Do not include any Chinese text or extra slogans.
CHARACTER LOCK: The six labeled cutouts in input image 3 are ORIGINAL existing app character cutouts. Their designs are immutable, not loose references. Reuse their original anatomy, face, eyes, hair/helmet/hat, costume, colors, original ink/hatching and gesture. Do not redesign them or give them new facial expressions or outfits. Crop original art to large readable head-and-shoulders framing. No full bodies. No generic emoji replacements. In paired icons, both original faces must remain clearly visible; separate heads with comfortable negative space. A duo is ONE shared joined sticker, not two separate stickers.

INPUT MAPPING:
1. previous four-icon sheet, use ONLY bottom-right icon 19 as style/structure reference.
2. source wordmark image, use English ONEBEAT only.
3. A SIX-CHARACTER ORIGINAL ART REFERENCE SHEET. Its labels identify the actual characters, not text to copy into the finished icons:
TOP LEFT, CLOUD: bright blue SINGLE-eyed cloud companion with original fluffy white cloud hair, rainbow clip, pink cheeks and wing.
TOP CENTER, TEAPOT: original mint-green teapot character with original lid knob, long spout, small oval black eye, orange nose, blush cheek and pink striped apron.
TOP RIGHT, MISMATCH: original cyan-blue beanie walker with dark teal hair/knit beanie, rectangular half-closed eye and black-white striped top, purple elbow pad.
BOTTOM LEFT, WAVE: original right-facing girl with pink-purple bob, original large dark eye, yellow overalls/cyan top, bent walking fist.
BOTTOM CENTER, SCOOTER: original pale-skinned black-helmet character with obscuring dark fringe and acid-yellow/green jacket.
BOTTOM RIGHT, LILROLL: original purple-skinned character with lime-green dotted helmet, dark green fringe, half-closed original eyes, purple hoodie.
Do not copy the labels or reference sheet's grid into the final design.

FOUR VARIANTS:
20 TOP LEFT — CLOUD SOLO: one large original CLOUD face/upper body above the teal ONEBEAT. Preserve the single eye, original cheerful mouth, rainbow clip and wing. Cloud-hair contour makes a memorable scalloped top edge for the thick sticker badge. Compact friendly silhouette.
21 TOP RIGHT — TEAPOT SOLO: one large original TEAPOT head and upper apron above the wordmark. Let the teapot lid and spout define a unique lively badge contour; preserve original details and keep the whole head/spout legible. Original tiny steam curl only if it remains uncluttered. No added drum or new pose.
22 BOTTOM LEFT — WALKING DUO: original MISMATCH on the left/back and original WAVE on the right/front, BOTH facing their ORIGINAL rightward direction. Two faces remain separately readable, same approximate visual head size, neither face hidden by the other's hair. Original shoulder/arm details may overlap naturally above the wordmark. One shared warm-ivory border and thick near-black extruded side around the full joined character-plus-ONEBEAT silhouette.
23 BOTTOM RIGHT — SKATER DUO: original LILROLL on the left and original SCOOTER on the right, retaining their original gestures and expressions. Distinguish the lime helmet/purple hoodie from the black helmet/acid-yellow jacket. Both faces clear, stagger the two heads just enough to fit a compact badge; no oversized empty gap. One common ONEBEAT base and continuous thick cream border/black underside.

GLOBAL quality: must feel like four members of the SAME icon family as selected 19. Large brand emblem fills central 80–86% of each square with lavender corners left clear for OS clipping. Thick cream keyline follows all contours cleanly, black extrusion consistent down-right, no soft atmospheric shadows, no extra decorative objects, no environment, no circular portrait frames, no text other than the ONEBEAT wordmark within icons and 20/21/22/23 numbering below. Crisp polished app-icon art, confident contrast and readable at small sizes.
